The relationships are statements of the form "X is Y's ancestor" or "X is Y's descendant". Note that these are directional: "X is Y's ancestor" means X is an ancestor of Y (X -> ... -> Y). "X is Y's descendant" means X is a descendant of Y (Y is ancestor of X). So we can interpret each as a directed edge from ancestor to descendant. So we have many directed relationships.

We need to see if from these we can deduce the relationship between Emma and Justine: either Emma is descendant of Justine, or they share a common descendant, or Emma is ancestor of Justine, or they share a common ancestor, or none.

We need to trace paths.

We need to see if there is any chain linking Emma to Justine (ancestor/descendant) or if they have a common ancestor/descendant.

We should parse all relationships and look for connections involving Emma and Justine.
